name: @alalanet/x402-guard
description: Fetch wrapper that asks alalanet before an x402 payment is signed: blocks unknown payTo, bait-and-switch prices and sanctioned addresses; never pays twice for one purchase (re-presents the signed payment on retries, reconciles on chain); per-call, daily and per-seller budgets; warns about x402 SDK versions with known flaws.
author: alalanet <noreply@alalanet.com>
